info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens File Metadata API
Hubspot Retrieve File or Folder Metadata

params.name: environment
params.description: The target environment for the operation (draft or published)

params.name: path
params.description: The file system path to the file or folder

params.name: properties
params.description: Specific properties to include in the response

items.docs:
Retrieves metadata for a file or folder at the specified path in the specified environment.
For folders, includes a list of child files and subfolders.
